name: offwork-capsule
description: Capture and resume trustworthy Agent handoffs from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Package current work into a trusted Capsule.
interface.longDescription: Capture a structured, auditable handoff from the current Codex workspace and resume it in a fresh Agent Session.
defaultPrompt: Use $offwork capture to package the current work into a trusted handoff.
Use $offwork resume to continue from an existing Offwork Capsule.
